name: Alien Invasion

specialAbility.name: Tractor Beam
specialAbility.description: Alien Invasion activates its glowing tractor beam and sucks 15 HP right out of the enemy truck!

lore: Nobody believed little Timmy when he said a UFO landed in his backyard — until a glowing green monster truck zoomed out of the crater the next morning! Alien Invasion has a giant alien eye on the roof, hover-glow under the chassis, and a tractor beam that can steal energy from anything it zaps!
